Header banner for /pages/brightening-glow.

SOURCE: banner library v2, glutathione-brightening-serum--A-face-full-prod-left gpt_image_01 (2048x848, 2.42:1). The v2 set, not the superseded v1 in _superseded/glutathione-v1-opaque-bottle.

EXTENDED RIGHT, WHICH THE SCRIPT COULD NOT DO UNTIL NOW. Subject and bottle are on the LEFT here, so the room has to be made on the right. Rather than write a mirrored copy of extend_left - whose edge profile, shear, texture tiling and join blend are all tuned and all assume a left edge - the frame is flipped, extended, and flipped back, so the output matches the source in orientation, label included. The phone crop is anchored to the SUBJECT side, which is now the left; anchoring it to the extension would have produced a rectangle of empty backdrop.

MEASURED FIRST: the rightmost columns read mean 24-31 with a max of 32 top to bottom, i.e. flat backdrop, so nothing had to be sheared out of frame. Texture sampled from rows 0-400 across the last 700px, max 39 against a backdrop of ~31.

3750x848 (4.42:1), past the 4.36:1 the 100vw x 440px header reaches at a 1920 viewport, so the full height survives every common desktop width.

TWO SETTINGS CHANGED WITH IT, AND WHY. overlay_opacity was 70 - more than double the section's own default of 30, and well past the 50 that this project has already recorded as 'muting the picture to near-flat, which is why a new image read as no change'. At 70 the swap would have been close to invisible. Reduced to 28. And desktop_text_position moves from centre to centre-END: the subject now sits left and the extension is clean dark backdrop on the right, which is where white type belongs. Both are reversible from the backup the patch writes.

A BUG CAUGHT HERE, NOT SHIPPED. upload-theme-images.py reads the real filename back from Shopify by prefix, and matched skingenetix-glutathione-brightening-radiant-glow-serum.jpg to ...-radiant-glow-serum-COLLECTION.jpg, a different picture at 3000x920 uploaded by another session that happens to share the first 40 characters. It would have published the wrong image. The matcher now requires an exact stem match and only falls back to prefix when there is no exact one.

OBJECT-POSITION HAD TO BE INJECTED, AND THE FIRST PUBLISH PROVED WHY. The image went live at 100% height but the centred cover crop ate the BOTTLE off the left edge - at a 1440 viewport only 74% of the width is shown, taken evenly off both sides, and the bottle sits at x 60-350 of the 2048 source. Unlike the collection banners this section exposes no object-position setting, so a scoped <style> is appended as a custom-html section pinning it to left center. The crop then only ever removes the extension on the right, which is what the extension is for.

TEXT CENTRED at Malcolm's request, 2026-08-24: desktop_text_position moves from centre-end/right-aligned to centre/centre-aligned. Checked afterwards for contrast, since the subject sits left in this frame and a centred block reaches back toward her.
